bio: Domenico Grimani stands as a testament to the meritocratic possibilities within La Serenissima, having risen from the salt-crusted docks to command a commercial empire worth over half a million ducats. His journey began with calloused hands loading cargo at Riva di Santa Maria Formosa Piccola, where he absorbed the whispered secrets of trade routes and market dynamics that would later fuel his ascent.
